description: May 11 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 3, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 11 birthday falls in Taurus, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a May 11 birthday
paragraphs: Taurus enters its Saturn decan on the 11th, borrowing discipline from Capricorn, and the date carries master number 11, kept unreduced in numerology. That pairing is often read as intuition anchored in endurance: inspired ideas given time, structure and a budget. Twenty degrees into the Bull, the Sun favours patience, so the vision tends to arrive slowly and then stay.

By noon UTC on May 11, the Sun has normally reached roughly 20° of Taurus. That places the date in the Taurus decan that astrologers give to Saturn, the third of three. The closing decan of Taurus answers to Saturn, ruler of Capricorn, and this lends the sign's earthiness a long-range, structural quality. Instead of only enjoying what is solid, mid-May natives are often drawn to building it: savings, institutions, skills that compound over decades. Astrologers tend to call them serious, reliable and quietly ambitious, with a dry humour that surfaces once trust is established. Saturn can also bring a heavier sense of duty and a habit of postponing pleasure until some imagined finish line. Remembering that Taurus is a Venus sign first can help, because rest and beauty belong inside the structure too.

sections.heading: Numerology of the May 11 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same May 11 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: May 11 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 11 is the 131st day of the year (132nd in a leap year). In most years Gemini season is under way by May 21, 10 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 11 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. May 11 is also the birthday of Salvador Dalí (1904), Richard Feynman (1918) and Andrés Iniesta (1984).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 11?
faq.answer: May 11 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 11 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 11?
faq.answer: By May 11 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 11?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a May 11 birthday are Salvador Dalí (1904), Richard Feynman (1918) and Andrés Iniesta (1984). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
